categories.desc: Instant reactions when something great happens.
cards: Génial !
Great! / Awesome!
The most common positive reaction. Also in full: c'est génial !
— J'ai eu mon permis ! — Génial !
— I passed my driving test! — Awesome!
Trop bien !
So good! / Awesome!
Trop here means ‘really’, not ‘too’. Casual and very popular.
Trop bien, on a des places au premier rang !
Awesome, we've got front-row seats!
Trop cool !
So cool!
Laid-back and young.
Ton nouvel appart est trop cool !
Your new apartment is so cool!
C'est top !
That's great! / Perfect!
Casual. Often just top ! on its own.
— On se fait un ciné ce soir ? — Ah, top !
— Movie tonight? — Oh, great!
C'est chouette !
That's lovely! / How nice!
Warm and a little old-school, but still widely used. Also before a noun: une chouette idée.
C'est chouette que tu puisses venir !
It's great that you can come!
C'est le pied !
It's heaven! / It's the best!
Casual: something is a real pleasure.
Une semaine à la plage sans réveil, c'est le pied !
A week at the beach with no alarm clock is heaven!

categories.desc: Looking forward to something coming up.
cards: J'ai hâte !
I can't wait!
Add de + infinitive or que + subjunctive: j'ai hâte que ça commence. Casual and stronger: j'ai trop hâte !
J'ai hâte de partir en vacances !
I can't wait to go on vacation!
Le concert, c'est samedi ? J'ai trop hâte !
The concert's on Saturday? I can't wait!
Vivement… !
Roll on…! / I can't wait for…!
Followed by a noun, or by que + subjunctive.
Vivement le week-end !
Roll on the weekend!
Vivement que l'été arrive !
I can't wait for summer!
Je compte les jours !
I'm counting the days!
Something you've been looking forward to for a while.
Plus que deux semaines avant le mariage, je compte les jours !
Only two weeks until the wedding, I'm counting the days!
Je ne tiens plus en place !
I can't sit still!
Too excited, or too impatient, to stay put. Spoken: je tiens plus en place.
Elle part demain pour le Japon, elle ne tient plus en place.
She leaves for Japan tomorrow and can't sit still.
Ça va être génial !
It's going to be great!
Excitement about a plan. Also ça va être top.
On part tous ensemble en Bretagne, ça va être génial !
We're all going to Brittany together, it's going to be great!

categories.desc: Saying just how thrilled you are.
cards: Je suis aux anges !
I'm over the moon!
Literally ‘I'm with the angels’.
Elle a dit oui ! Je suis aux anges !
She said yes! I'm over the moon!
Je suis ravi(e) !
I'm delighted!
Polite and versatile. With que it takes the subjunctive.
Je suis ravie que tu aies accepté.
I'm delighted you've accepted.
Je suis trop content(e) !
I'm so happy!
Everyday and casual. Trop again means ‘really’.
Je suis trop content de te revoir !
I'm so happy to see you again!
J'en reviens pas !
I can't believe it!
Amazed disbelief, usually happy. Written: je n'en reviens pas.
J'ai gagné le concours ! J'en reviens pas !
I won the competition! I can't believe it!
C'est trop beau pour être vrai !
It's too good to be true!
Here trop does mean ‘too’.
Un vol à trente euros pour Rome ? C'est trop beau pour être vrai !
A thirty-euro flight to Rome? It's too good to be true!

categories.desc: Shouts of joy, and cheering someone on.
cards: Youhou !
Woohoo!
A shout of joy, also spelled wouhou. Careful: youhou ! is also ‘yoo-hoo!’ to get someone's attention.
Youhou ! On est en finale !
Woohoo! We're in the final!
Allez !
Come on! / Go!
Cheering someone on. In sport: allez les Bleus !
Allez, allez, tu y es presque !
Come on, come on, you're almost there!
Trop fort !
Amazing! / Impressive!
Admiration for something impressive. Of a person: t'es trop fort(e) !
Tu as fini le marathon ? Trop fort !
You finished the marathon? Amazing!
C'est parti !
Here we go! / Let's go!
Excitement at the start of something.
Tout le monde est prêt ? C'est parti !
Is everyone ready? Here we go!
